news.title: Favorable views of Supreme Court remain near historic low
news.summary_en: Half of Americans currently hold an unfavorable opinion of the Supreme Court, while roughly as many view the court favorably.

news.title: How Pew Research Center is – and is not – using AI in our work
news.summary_en: In this post, we’ll share our current guidelines for the internal use of artificial intelligence and potential areas of experimentation.

news.title: Video: How precise are polls really?
news.summary_en: How precise are polls … really? Here’s a little secret: Even the best pollsters need some wiggle room when sharing results. This “wiggle room” (also known as the margin of error) is the range within the true answer likely falls.

news.title: More Americans now support than oppose all-day school cellphone bans
news.summary_en: Three-quarters of U.S. adults support in-class school cellphone bans, and for the first time, more now support than oppose all-day bans for middle and high schoolers.
